characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: EMPYREAN, PANALYTICAL with Co-Kalpha source; operating voltage 40 kV, operating current 40 mA
characterization_methods.key_findings: Low intensity XRD peaks of all the elements have vanished after 5 h of milling, indicating the onset of alloying; the diffraction peak intensity of all the elements decreases with milling time.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: scan rate 5 deg min-1; patterns collected after every 5 h of milling (panel a of Fig. 1 includes the 5 h pattern)
characterization_methods.purpose: To ascertain the alloying behavior during milling and phase evolution of the powder as a function of milling time.

processing_steps.atmosphere: toluene (process control reagent, to avoid oxidation)
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Planetary ball mill (Model no. PM 400/2, Retsch) at 200 rpm; ball-to-powder ratio 10:1; milling carried out in tungsten carbide (WC) vials with WC balls; milling stopped intermittently for 20 min after every 1 h to avoid overheating. 2-3 g of milled powder taken after every 5 h of milling to study phase evolution.

structures.overall_structure: Mechanically alloyed powder after 5 h of milling showing the onset of alloying: the low-intensity XRD peaks of all constituent elements have vanished. No new intermetallic/solid-solution phase (BCC, gamma-brass type or B2-type) is reported at this stage; the vanishing of low-intensity elemental peaks indicates the initiation of alloying.

unmapped_findings: The 5 h milled state belongs to the milling-time series (0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 h) used to track phase evolution; 2-3 g of milled powder was withdrawn after every 5 h of milling for XRD analysis (b0020, figure_001).

During milling the C (interstitial) dissolves faster than the other alloying elements due to its smaller atomic size and higher diffusivity; Al begins to dissolve (intensity diminishes) only after 15 h of milling; after 20 h intense Ni and Mn peaks are no longer evident, and a solid solution is formed after 25 h of milling (b0038, b0058).

The elemental diffraction peaks indexed in the milled powders (relevant to the 5 h state) are Fe (cI2, JCPDS# 00-006-0696), Mn (cI58, JCPDS# 00-032-0637), Ni (cF4, JCPDS# 00-004-0850), Al (cF4, JCPDS# 00-004-0787), Si (cF8, JCPDS# 00-005-0565) and C (hP4, JCPDS# 00-056-0159) (b0038).
